# Niuexa

> Niuexa (NIUEXA S.R.L.) is an AI consultancy for Italian SMEs, with offices in
> Turin and Milan. It measures a business process as it is, automates it with AI
> agents built on the systems the company already uses, measures again, and then
> decides with the client whether to extend, correct or stop. Exceptions go to a
> person: the agent proposes, the person decides. Niuexa publishes no prices and
> guarantees no savings figures; the first 30-minute call is free.

## Main Sections
- [About Us](https://niuexa.ai/en/about-us.html): The founders, Gregor Maric
  (CEO) and Roberto Botto, and how Niuexa works.
- [Consulting](https://niuexa.ai/en/consulting.html): Process analysis and
  measurement, use cases ranked by priority, implementation on existing systems.
- [Training](https://niuexa.ai/en/training.html): Practical AI training for
  teams and managers, in person or online.
- [Products](https://niuexa.ai/en/products.html): AI agents for sales,
  marketing and customer service, with human approval on critical steps.

## Resources
- [Learn](https://niuexa.ai/en/learn.html): Practical tutorials and guides
- [Events](https://niuexa.ai/en/events.html): Niuexa evenings on AI in business in Milan (in Italian)
- [AI-readiness analysis](https://niuexa.ai/en/ai-readiness-tool.html): Free check of whether AI assistants can find and cite your site
